user.title: EG4 GridBOSS Setup
user.description: Enter the connection details for your EG4 monitoring dongle. The dongle must be reachable from your Home Assistant host — either via its own AP (10.10.10.1) or on your LAN.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the dongle. Check the IP, port, and that your HA host is on the same network as the dongle.
